0.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_001
0.description: Well met. I am an OIC quartermaster affiliated with the <hex:020938E802FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D657303>, and it is my duty to provide those free companies who have pledged their allegiance to our Grand Company with the opportunity to purchase various enchantments and items which will benefit their members.
0.translation_description: Benvenuto. Sono un ufficiale OIC addetto ai rifornimenti, affiliato alla <hex:02093FE802FF0C4C612054656D7065737461FF1C4F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF114669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C6903> e incaricato di offrire alle compagnie libere che hanno giurato fedeltà alla nostra Grande Compagnia la possibilità di acquistare vari potenziamenti e oggetti utili ai loro membri.

6.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_010
6.description: Credits are the currency free companies use in place of standard gil or company seals.
6.translation_description: I crediti sono la valuta usata dalle compagnie libere al posto dei gil o dei sigilli della compagnia.

7.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_011
7.description: Credits are earned by members fulfilling various duties in the name of their company.
7.translation_description: I membri guadagnano crediti svolgendo varie attività in nome della propria compagnia.

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_012
8.description: This currency can be exchanged for various items with an officer affiliated with the Grand Company to whom your free company has pledged its allegiance.
8.translation_description: Puoi scambiare questi crediti con vari oggetti da un ufficiale della Grande Compagnia a cui la tua compagnia libera ha giurato fedeltà.

9.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_013
9.description: These types of exchanges can only be carried out if and when your company has been granted the right to do so by its allied Grand Company.
9.translation_description: Questo tipo di scambio è possibile solo se la Grande Compagnia alleata ha autorizzato la tua compagnia.

10.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_014
10.description: Also, your company master must grant you the authorization to use the credits.
10.translation_description: Inoltre, per usare i crediti devi ricevere l'autorizzazione dal capo della tua compagnia.

11.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_ERR1
11.description: I say. Have you ever considered joining a free company? If not, might I suggest you do so? A whole new world will open.
11.translation_description: A proposito, hai mai pensato di unirti a una compagnia libera? Se non ci hai mai pensato, te lo consiglio: ti si aprirà un mondo nuovo.

13.name: TEXT_COMDEFFREECOMPANYREWARD_00100_TALK_ACTOR_ERR3
13.description: It would seem that your free company is affiliated with another Grand Company. I'm afraid I cannot offer you my services.
13.translation_description: Pare che la tua compagnia libera sia affiliata a una Grande Compagnia diversa. Mi spiace, ma non posso offrirti i miei servizi.
